abstract: Anti-N-methyl-d-aspartate receptor (anti-NMDAR) encephalitis is an acute form of encephalitis with an autoimmune etiology. We aimed to study clinical characteristics and treatment outcomes and assess the predictive factors associated with patient outcome. In this retrospective study, patients who presented with cardinal symptoms of anti-NMDA encephalitis and positive anti-NMDA receptor antibody results in their cerebrospinal fluid were included in the study. Thirty-one patients were identified. The median age of onset was 19 years (IQR 15.0-31.0). Females were predominant (61.8%). The main clinical symptoms were neuropsychiatric symptoms (87.1%) followed by abnormal movement (71%), seizures (51.1%), and autonomic instability (41.9%). Eleven patients (35.5%) exhibited decreased levels of consciousness. Abnormal MRI results were found in only 35.5% of the patients. CSF abnormalities usually involved mild pleocytosis. Only 67.7% of serum samples were positive against the anti-NMDAR antibody, whereas 100% of CSF samples were positive. Tumor-related information was only available for 20 patients. Only one case involved an ovarian teratoma. All patients received first-line therapy (intravenous pulse methylprednisolone and plasmapheresis). Three patients were treated with second-line therapy (IV cyclophosphamide). Twenty patients (64.5%) had favorable outcomes in our cohort (mRS 0-2) after a 1-year follow-up. An abnormal level of consciousness was a factor associated with a nonfavorable outcome (OR 15.65, 95% CI 2.30-106.29, p value <0.01).
abstract_ja: 抗N-メチル-D-アスパラギン酸受容体(抗NMDAR)脳炎は、自己免疫を原因とする急性型の脳炎である。本研究は、臨床的特徴と治療転帰を調べ、患者の転帰に関連する予測因子を評価することを目的とした。本後方視的研究では、抗NMDA脳炎の主要症状を呈し、脳脊髄液中の抗NMDA受容体抗体が陽性の患者を対象とした。31例が同定された。発症時の年齢中央値は19歳(IQR 15.0-31.0)であった。女性が多かった(61.8%)。主な臨床症状は神経精神症状(87.1%)、次いで異常運動(71%)、痙攣(51.1%)、自律神経不安定(41.9%)であった。11例(35.5%)で意識レベルの低下が認められた。MRIの異常所見は35.5%の患者でのみ認められた。脳脊髄液の異常は通常、軽度の細胞増多であった。血清試料で抗NMDAR抗体が陽性だったのは67.7%のみであったが、脳脊髄液試料では100%が陽性であった。腫瘍関連の情報は20例でのみ得られた。卵巣奇形腫は1例のみであった。全患者が一次治療(静脈内パルスメチルプレドニゾロンと血漿交換)を受けた。3例は二次治療(静脈内シクロホスファミド)を受けた。1年間のフォローアップ後、20例(64.5%)が良好な転帰(mRS 0-2)を示した。意識レベルの低下は、不良な転帰と関連する因子であった(OR 15.65、95%CI 2.30-106.29、p値<0.01)。
